entries.title: Zechariah 10:1
segments: ¶Ask the LORD for rain In the time of the latter rain. The LORD will make flashing clouds; He will give them showers of rain, Grass in the field for everyone.

entries.title: Zechariah 10:2
segments: For the idols speak delusion; The diviners envision lies, And tell false dreams; They comfort in vain. Therefore [the people] wend their way like sheep; They are in trouble because [there is] no shepherd.

entries.title: Zechariah 10:3
segments: "My anger is kindled against the shepherds, And I will punish the goatherds. For the LORD of hosts will visit His flock, The house of Judah, And will make them as His royal horse in the battle.

entries.title: Zechariah 10:4
segments: From him comes the cornerstone, From him the tent peg, From him the battle bow, From him every ruler together.

entries.title: Zechariah 10:5
segments: ¶They shall be like mighty men, Who tread down [their enemies] In the mire of the streets in the battle. They shall fight because the LORD is with them, And the riders on horses shall be put to shame.

entries.title: Zechariah 10:6
segments: "I will strengthen the house of Judah, And I will save the house of Joseph. I will bring them back, Because I have mercy on them. They shall be as though I had not cast them aside; For I [am] the LORD their God, And I will hear them.

entries.title: Zechariah 10:7
segments: [Those of] Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, And their heart shall rejoice as if with wine. Yes, their children shall see [it] and be glad; Their heart shall rejoice in the LORD.

entries.title: Zechariah 10:8
segments: I will whistle for them and gather them, For I will redeem them; And they shall increase as they once increased.

entries.title: Zechariah 10:9
segments: "I will sow them among the peoples, And they shall remember Me in far countries; They shall live, together with their children, And they shall return.

entries.title: Zechariah 10:10
segments: I will also bring them back from the land of Egypt, And gather them from Assyria. I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon, Until no [more room] is found for them.

entries.title: Zechariah 10:11
segments: He shall pass through the sea with affliction, And strike the waves of the sea: All the depths of the River shall dry up. Then the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, And the scepter of Egypt shall depart.

entries.title: Zechariah 10:12
segments: "So I will strengthen them in the LORD, And they shall walk up and down in His name," Says the LORD.
